# directive: every phase against every stimulus: the next phase, or the misfit that leaves it unchanged.
# Every phase is reachable: received on every frame admitted to the table, reobserving for StopVm/DeleteVm, the rest from those.
received x admit_reobserve -> executing re_observe
received x admit_effect -> executing effect
received x deny_safe_mode -> refused safe_mode
received x reobserved_match -> misfit not_re_observing
received x reobserved_mismatch -> misfit not_re_observing
received x reobserve_failed -> misfit not_re_observing
received x applied_vm_cloned -> misfit not_running
received x applied_a_refusal -> misfit not_running
received x applied_an_unknown -> misfit not_running
received x applied_a_fact -> misfit not_running
received x failed -> misfit not_running
received x ambiguous_deadline -> misfit not_running
received x ambiguous_process_lost -> misfit not_running
received x ambiguous_host_slept -> misfit not_running
received x ambiguous_stale_epoch -> misfit not_running
reobserving x admit_reobserve -> misfit not_received
reobserving x admit_effect -> misfit not_received
reobserving x deny_safe_mode -> misfit not_received
reobserving x reobserved_match -> executing effect
reobserving x reobserved_mismatch -> refused proof_mismatch
reobserving x reobserve_failed -> refused effect_failed
reobserving x applied_vm_cloned -> misfit not_running
reobserving x applied_a_refusal -> misfit not_running
reobserving x applied_an_unknown -> misfit not_running
reobserving x applied_a_fact -> misfit not_running
reobserving x failed -> misfit not_running
reobserving x ambiguous_deadline -> misfit not_running
reobserving x ambiguous_process_lost -> misfit not_running
reobserving x ambiguous_host_slept -> misfit not_running
reobserving x ambiguous_stale_epoch -> misfit not_running
executing x admit_reobserve -> misfit not_received
executing x admit_effect -> misfit not_received
executing x deny_safe_mode -> misfit not_received
executing x reobserved_match -> misfit not_re_observing
executing x reobserved_mismatch -> misfit not_re_observing
executing x reobserve_failed -> misfit not_re_observing
executing x applied_vm_cloned -> done (applied vm_cloned)
executing x applied_a_refusal -> misfit not_an_application
executing x applied_an_unknown -> misfit not_an_application
executing x applied_a_fact -> misfit not_an_application
executing x failed -> refused effect_failed
executing x ambiguous_deadline -> unknown deadline
executing x ambiguous_process_lost -> unknown process_lost
executing x ambiguous_host_slept -> unknown host_slept
executing x ambiguous_stale_epoch -> misfit not_an_effect_outcome
done x admit_reobserve -> misfit settled
done x admit_effect -> misfit settled
done x deny_safe_mode -> misfit settled
done x reobserved_match -> misfit settled
done x reobserved_mismatch -> misfit settled
done x reobserve_failed -> misfit settled
done x applied_vm_cloned -> misfit settled
done x applied_a_refusal -> misfit settled
done x applied_an_unknown -> misfit settled
done x applied_a_fact -> misfit settled
done x failed -> misfit settled
done x ambiguous_deadline -> misfit settled
done x ambiguous_process_lost -> misfit settled
done x ambiguous_host_slept -> misfit settled
done x ambiguous_stale_epoch -> misfit settled
refused x admit_reobserve -> misfit settled
refused x admit_effect -> misfit settled
refused x deny_safe_mode -> misfit settled
refused x reobserved_match -> misfit settled
refused x reobserved_mismatch -> misfit settled
refused x reobserve_failed -> misfit settled
refused x applied_vm_cloned -> misfit settled
refused x applied_a_refusal -> misfit settled
refused x applied_an_unknown -> misfit settled
refused x applied_a_fact -> misfit settled
refused x failed -> misfit settled
refused x ambiguous_deadline -> misfit settled
refused x ambiguous_process_lost -> misfit settled
refused x ambiguous_host_slept -> misfit settled
refused x ambiguous_stale_epoch -> misfit settled
unknown x admit_reobserve -> misfit settled
unknown x admit_effect -> misfit settled
unknown x deny_safe_mode -> misfit settled
unknown x reobserved_match -> misfit settled
unknown x reobserved_mismatch -> misfit settled
unknown x reobserve_failed -> misfit settled
unknown x applied_vm_cloned -> misfit settled
unknown x applied_a_refusal -> misfit settled
unknown x applied_an_unknown -> misfit settled
unknown x applied_a_fact -> misfit settled
unknown x failed -> misfit settled
unknown x ambiguous_deadline -> misfit settled
unknown x ambiguous_process_lost -> misfit settled
unknown x ambiguous_host_slept -> misfit settled
unknown x ambiguous_stale_epoch -> misfit settled
